name: bat_to_goal_rightedge_v1_vectorized_wall_clock
description: Panda batting benchmark with a fixed wall-clock training window for vectorized data-collection candidates.
notes: Use this benchmark when comparing bat-to-goal training approaches under equal wall-clock time.
train_episodes is a high safety cap; train_seconds is the intended budget.
Use seed_trainable_vectorized.py so candidate code can mutate vector env count, batch size, update cadence, and rendering cadence to improve utilization.
Evaluation remains single-environment and uses the fixed eval case bank.
